fields.summary_ko.0: Dell Technologies (DELL) rose 130.2% over past 12 months, overwhelming the computer and technology sector's 2.9% gain, driven by AI infrastructure business expansion and surging AI-optimized server demand.
fields.summary_ko.1: AI server orders reached $131.7B over past 12 months with $95B backlog, 2027 AI server revenue expected to triple YoY to $74B.
fields.summary_ko.2: Legacy server and networking revenue increased 122% YoY to $10.5B in Q2, with enterprise AI adoption at 10-15% levels suggesting substantial additional demand potential.
